edges.reason: mint is guarded by allow("SkaleManager") which inspects msg.sender.
slash is guarded by allow("SkaleDKG") comparing msg.sender to registered contract.
setCompleted restricted modifier compares msg.sender with owner.
setContractsAddress is onlyOwner, depending on msg.sender.
tokensReceived is guarded by allow("SkaleToken") checking msg.sender.
adjustPrice relies on now for cooldown and timeSkipped, enabling timestamp dependency.
changeNodeLastRewardDate stores block.timestamp as reward date.
getBounty uses now to compute reward periods and stage transitions.
getCurrentMonth derives month from block.timestamp.
timestampToMonth converts timestamp input to month index.
_send invokes _callTokensReceived recipient hook after state moves.
_send invokes _callTokensToSend sender hook allowing external control.
tokensToSend calls an arbitrary registered implementer contract.
tokensReceived calls an arbitrary registered implementer contract.
overridden _callTokensToSend is protected by nonReentrant modifier.
overridden _callTokensReceived is protected by nonReentrant modifier.
untrusted external hook can re-enter and interact with _status guarded state.
sendValue executes the low-level call that transfers control to recipient.
transferFrom triggers recipient hook after allowance/balance accounting.
mint calls the tokens received hook after updating supply and balances.
recover invokes ecrecover to derive the signer address.
bigModExp performs a staticcall to precompile 0x05.
bn256ScalarMul performs a staticcall to precompile 0x07.
bn256Pairing performs a staticcall to precompile 0x08.
_setNodeLeft mutates counters with raw unchecked -- and ++ operations.
adjustPrice reassigns price via arithmetic on load and capacity values.
recipient parameter is the target of the low-level value call.
amount parameter is the value forwarded to the recipient call.
signature parameter is split into r,s,v fed to ecrecover.
amount parameter drives the minted quantity and CAP check.
amount parameter is moved and deducted from allowance in transferFrom.
capacity local is used as divisor in price change computation.
nodeIndex parameter selects the node whose reward date is updated.
validatorId parameter selects the validator to slash.
base parameter is passed to the bigModExp precompile.
value parameter is forwarded as schain deposit on token receipt.
restricted modifier gates upgrade via setCompleted ownership logic.
Pricing.initialize calls Permissions.initialize to set up roles.
mint invokes _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state changes.
_send indirectly triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook via _move.
upgrade performs an external call to setCompleted on the new contract.
